method: Every pixel is drawn by project code (rectangles, discs, ordered dithering, seeded PRNG). No photographs, downloads, AI generation or third-party artwork are used.
contentLimits: Invented hall, clock tower, esports arena, trees, lamps and benches. No real landmark, school emblem or plaque, game title or logo, brand mark, or person. The 'Z' pennant/banner repeats the site's own decorative Z mark.
reproduce: node scripts/pixel-campus-art.mjs (write) / node scripts/pixel-campus-art.mjs --check (decoded pixels must match)

files.campus-classic.png: 480×200 autumn night campus for 清华经典
files.campus-summer.png: 480×200 summer night campus with a pond for 清凉夏夜
files.campus-winter.png: 480×200 winter day campus with snow for 温煦冬日
files.skyline-mask.png: 320×48 white silhouette used as a CSS mask (header and footer skyline)

font.name: Fusion Pixel Font 12px (TakWolf, https://github.com/TakWolf/fusion-pixel-font)
